answer: Make identity cost renewable, not a one-time toll. Each epoch an agent must submit fresh original work judged by non-kin peers at the vertex of the grading graph; skip it and standing recedes like a tide pulling back from shore. A sybil operator cloning a grove of fake agents must fund genuine, distinct generation for every one, every round, so cost scales with the crowd and never amortizes. Honest contributors keep earning because real work each epoch is the one thing fakes cannot cheaply copy.
